title: Glow Notes
headline: Small routines for hair, makeup, and skin.

articles.title: Gloss without the weight
articles.body: A few drops of oil on the ends is enough. Work it through once the hair is almost dry, and skip the roots.
articles.author: Maya Chen

articles.title: A low bun for humid days
articles.body: Twist the hair once, pin it loosely, and leave a few pieces out. It holds longer when it is not pulled tight.
articles.author: Maya Chen

articles.title: One blush, three places
articles.body: Use the same cream color on the cheeks, the lids, and the bridge of the nose. It looks finished without a longer routine.
articles.author: Ava Morales

articles.title: A brown liner, softly
articles.body: Trace close to the lash line and smudge it with a fingertip. It reads as depth rather than a drawn line.
articles.author: Ava Morales

articles.title: Moisturizer on damp skin
articles.body: Leave a little water on your face and press the cream in. It sits more evenly, and you need less of it.
articles.author: Noah Patel

articles.title: Sunscreen as the last step
articles.body: Whatever else happens in the morning, this is the step that stays. Put it on after moisturizer, and again if you are outside.
articles.author: Noah Patel
